headline: Microsoft 365 to cut shared-plan OneDrive storage allotments
summary: Microsoft is reducing the OneDrive cloud storage included with shared Microsoft 365 family plans, which currently offer 1 TB per family member. Subscribers could lose up to 4TB of storage, a change that may raise costs for heavy users while benefiting those who use less space.

claims.statement: Microsoft is reducing OneDrive storage allotments for shared Microsoft 365 family plans.
